channel.title: Zone3 guides
channel.description: Question-led kitchen buying guides and archived research notes — the canonical /guides/ pages, the Air Fryer Field Notes buying guides, the Research Desk articles and The Crisp Report field notes. Working titles; every quoted listing title is checked on the date shown; no price, rating or review count is reproduced and no traffic or ranking claim is made.
